acceptance: Crate aipo-ast implemented with typed AST nodes for all items, statements, and expressions.
Crate aipo-syntax implemented with Pratt expression parsing and recursive descent statement parsing.
Robust error recovery without panics on malformed input.
Support for trailing blocks, pipelines, destructuring bindings, and match statements.
Exhaustive tests passing with quality gates green.
constraints: Parser never panics on any token sequence.

evidence.description: cargo test -p aipo-ast -p aipo-syntax passed with 14 automated tests (1 ast, 13 syntax) covering expressions, statements, structs, impls, traits, patterns, and error recovery

non_goals: HIR lowering or semantic analysis (reserved for S4/S5).
objective: Implement aipo-syntax and aipo-ast with recursive descent and Pratt parsing for all statements and expressions
title: Parser Core: Lossless syntax and typed AST
